---
title: "Supplementary Wave-Map Explorer"
site: workflowr::wflow_site
output: workflowr::wflow_html
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/supplementary/supplementary_app.css">
```

Explore geographic summaries for every canonical pandemic wave. P-score maps
use a fixed color scale from -50% to +50% so colors remain comparable across
waves; exact values outside that range are retained in tooltips and the result
table. Excess-death maps use a selection-specific symmetric scale and state that
choice in the legend.

```{=html}
<div id="supplementary-wave-map" class="supp-app" data-supplementary-app="map" data-root="assets/supplementary">
  <div class="supp-controls" aria-label="Wave-map filters">
    <label>Map collection
      <select data-control="family"></select>
    </label>
    <label>Age group
      <select data-control="age"></select>
    </label>
    <label>Sex
      <select data-control="sex"></select>
    </label>
    <label>Wave
      <select data-control="wave"></select>
    </label>
    <label>Statistic
      <select data-control="statistic">
        <option value="p_median">Posterior median P-score</option>
        <option value="p_lower">P-score 2.5th percentile</option>
        <option value="p_upper">P-score 97.5th percentile</option>
        <option value="delta_median">Posterior median excess deaths</option>
      </select>
    </label>
  </div>

  <div class="supp-meta" data-role="metadata"></div>
  <div class="supp-map-layout">
    <div>
      <div class="supp-chart-shell supp-map-shell">
        <svg data-role="map" viewBox="0 0 920 560" role="img" aria-label="Selected wave-specific geographic summary"></svg>
        <div class="supp-tooltip" data-role="tooltip" hidden></div>
      </div>
      <div class="supp-map-legend" data-role="legend" aria-label="Map color legend"></div>
      <p class="supp-note" data-role="geometry-note"></p>
    </div>
    <div class="supp-map-table" data-role="table"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="supp-actions">
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-default" data-action="download">Download filtered wave results</button>
    <span class="supp-status" data-role="status" aria-live="polite">Loading frozen supplementary index…</span>
  </div>
</div>

<noscript>This explorer requires JavaScript. The complete wave table remains available from the <a href="supplementary.html">supplementary landing page</a>.</noscript>
```

The map geometry follows the manuscript plotting scope. United States results
for Alaska and Hawaii remain available in the table and in the time-series
explorer but are not drawn in the contiguous North America geometry. England
and Wales and the Republic of Ireland use distinct source age bands and remain
available in the time-series explorer rather than being silently mapped onto
Eurostat age bands.

<script src="assets/supplementary/supplementary_app.js"></script>
